files.content:
"use client";

import { Button, Group, HoverCard, Text } from '@mantine/core';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <HoverCard.Group openDelay={500} closeDelay={100}>
      <Group justify="center">
        <HoverCard shadow="md">
          <HoverCard.Target>
            <Button>First</Button>
          </HoverCard.Target>
          <HoverCard.Dropdown>
            <Text size="sm">First hover card content</Text>
          </HoverCard.Dropdown>
        </HoverCard>

        <HoverCard shadow="md">
          <HoverCard.Target>
            <Button>Second</Button>
          </HoverCard.Target>
          <HoverCard.Dropdown>
            <Text size="sm">Second hover card content</Text>
          </HoverCard.Dropdown>
        </HoverCard>

        <HoverCard shadow="md">
          <HoverCard.Target>
            <Button>Third</Button>
          </HoverCard.Target>
          <HoverCard.Dropdown>
            <Text size="sm">Third hover card content</Text>
          </HoverCard.Dropdown>
        </HoverCard>
      </Group>
    </HoverCard.Group>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

# Mantine hover card

4 published Mantine hover card examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
